sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个朴素说法展开：空气推压表面、开阔大气、轮胎内的封闭空气、气动工具、风道与客舱、声波、建筑所受的风压，以及人体的压力平衡。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tyre swelling until its wall feels hard under a thumb.
core.cn: 核心意象：轮胎鼓起，直到拇指按上去胎壁发硬。

branches.en: THE OPEN AIR: the plain push of air, and the atmosphere's own pressure.
branches.cn: 开阔空气：空气朴素的推力，以及大气本身的压强。

branches.en: ENCLOSED SPACES: tyres and cabins each hold their own pressure.
branches.cn: 密闭空间：轮胎与客舱各自持有一份压强。

branches.en: WORKING AIR: compressed air drives tools at a chosen value.
branches.cn: 工作空气：压缩空气以选定数值驱动工具。

branches.en: AIR IN MOTION: sound is a pressure ripple, and wind is a pressure load.
branches.cn: 运动空气：声是压强的涟漪，风是压强的载荷。

branches.en: THE BODY: ears and lungs must equalise what the air does.
branches.cn: 身体：耳与肺必须平衡空气造成的变化。

intro.en: Air pressure is a compound of a native English noun and a Latin borrowing, so its two halves belong to different layers of the vocabulary.
intro.cn: air pressure 是一个英语本族名词与一个拉丁借词的复合，两半属于词汇的不同层次。

latinIntro.en: Greek aēr passed through Latin aer into English air, while Latin premere and pressura supply pressure.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 aēr 经拉丁 aer 进入英语 air，而拉丁 premere 与 pressura 提供 pressure。

items.example: The Greek word named the misty air near the ground.
items.exampleCN: 这个希腊词指近地面带雾的空气。

items.structure: aer through Latin and Old French
items.meaning: the mixture of gases we breathe
items.example: Air fills the tyre.
items.exampleCN: 空气充满轮胎。

items.example: The verb supplies the push.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供推力。

items.example: Pressure rose inside the tank.
items.exampleCN: 罐内压强上升。

items.example: Air pressure kept the lid shut.
items.exampleCN: 气压把盖子压住。

items.example: An air-pressure gauge hung on the wall.
items.exampleCN: 墙上挂着气压表。

items.example: Atmospheric pressure is the formal term.
items.exampleCN: atmospheric pressure 是正式术语。

items.meaning: to raise the pressure of a space
items.example: The cabin is pressurized in flight.
items.exampleCN: 飞行中客舱增压。

items.example: Barometric readings were logged hourly.
items.exampleCN: 气压读数每小时记录。

definition_zh: 湿度；空气中水汽的含量；（常指）相对湿度
definition_en: the amount of water vapour in the air, usually reported as relative humidity
core_image: 一块湿布挂在封闭房间里，窗玻璃上凝着一层细小的水珠
scene: 梅雨季的午后，墙上挂着的毛巾一直不干，窗玻璃蒙着一层水汽。Humidity in the valley stayed above ninety per cent for a week.
sceneCN: 这里 humidity 指「空气中水汽的含量」（第 1 个义项：湿度总称）；句意为这个山谷的湿度连续一周超过九成。图中可辨识物件：湿毛巾、蒙雾的窗玻璃、水珠、温度计。

pos.zh: 湿度；潮湿（不可数名词）
相对湿度（天气报告中常省略「相对」）

forms.label: 复数（不同环境的湿度值）

senses.title: Water vapour in the air
senses.definition: the amount of water vapour present in the air
senses.definitionCN: 空气中水汽的含量
senses.example: Humidity in the valley stayed above ninety per cent for a week.
senses.exampleCN: 这个山谷的湿度连续一周超过九成。
senses.why: Latin humiditas named moistness, and meteorology narrowed it to vapour in the air.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 humiditas 本指潮湿，气象学把它收窄为空气中的水汽。

senses.title: Relative humidity
senses.definition: the ratio of actual vapour to the maximum the air could hold at that temperature
senses.definitionCN: 实际水汽与该温度下空气所能容纳最大水汽的比值
senses.example: At thirty degrees, a relative humidity of eighty per cent feels far hotter.
senses.exampleCN: 在三十度时，八成相对湿度让人感觉热得多。
senses.why: weather reports need a ratio that people can feel, so the relative form became the default.
senses.whyCN: 天气报告需要一个能被人感受到的比值，相对湿度因此成了默认说法。

senses.title: Absolute humidity
senses.definition: the mass of water vapour in a given volume of air
senses.definitionCN: 一定体积空气中所含水汽的质量
senses.example: Absolute humidity is measured in grams per cubic metre.
senses.exampleCN: 绝对湿度以每立方米克数计量。
senses.why: engineering needs an amount rather than a ratio, so the absolute form is named separately.
senses.whyCN: 工程需要的是量而非比值，绝对湿度因此单独命名。

senses.title: Specific humidity
senses.definition: the mass of vapour per unit mass of moist air
senses.definitionCN: 每单位质量湿空气中所含水汽的质量
senses.example: Specific humidity changes little when air rises and cools.
senses.exampleCN: 空气上升冷却时，比湿变化很小。
senses.why: meteorology prefers a measure that survives compression and expansion, hence the per-mass form.
senses.whyCN: 气象学偏爱一种在压缩与膨胀中仍稳定的量，于是有了按质量计的形式。

senses.title: Humidity as a felt quality
senses.definition: the uncomfortable dampness felt when the air is warm and full of vapour
senses.definitionCN: 空气温暖且饱含水汽时令人不适的潮湿感
senses.example: The humidity made the whole afternoon feel sticky.
senses.exampleCN: 这种湿度让整个下午都黏糊糊的。
senses.why: the measured quantity also has a felt side, and everyday speech uses the word for that.
senses.whyCN: 这个可测的量也有体感的一面，日常语言就用这个词来指那种感觉。

senses.title: A figure in a weather report
senses.titleCN: 天气报告中的湿度指标
senses.definition: the percentage or value reported alongside temperature in a forecast
senses.definitionCN: 预报中与温度并列报告的那个百分数或数值
senses.example: The forecast gave thirty-two degrees and high humidity.
senses.exampleCN: 预报给出三十二度与高湿度。
senses.why: a forecast needs a compact number, and humidity became one of its standard figures.
senses.whyCN: 预报需要一个紧凑的数字，湿度成了它的标准数值之一。

senses.title: A controlled target indoors
senses.definition: the humidity level maintained in a greenhouse, museum, hospital or home
senses.definitionCN: 温室、博物馆、医院或住宅中维持的湿度水平
senses.example: The archive keeps humidity steady to protect the paper.
senses.exampleCN: 档案馆保持湿度稳定以保护纸张。
senses.why: materials need a narrow band of moisture, so buildings and museums control the value.
senses.whyCN: 材料需要一个很窄的水汽区间，建筑与博物馆因此控制这个数值。

senses.title: Effects on materials and health
senses.titleCN: 湿度对材料与健康的影响
senses.definition: the practical effects of moisture on wood, metal, lungs and skin
senses.definitionCN: 水汽对木材、金属、肺与皮肤的实际影响
senses.example: High humidity warped the floorboards within a season.
senses.exampleCN: 高湿度在一个季度内就让地板变形。
senses.why: the quantity has consequences, and the word extends to those consequences in building and health science.
senses.whyCN: 这个量有后果，这个词就延伸到建筑与健康科学中的这些后果。

intro.en: Humidity comes from Latin humiditas, a noun from humidus 'moist', itself from humere 'to be moist'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: humidity 来自拉丁 humiditas，它是 humidus「潮湿的」的名词形式，而 humidus 出自 humere「潮湿」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Humere meant 'to be moist'. Its deeper origin is not established, and the Indo-European root often cited for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: humere 意为「潮湿」。其更深来源未得到证明，常为它引用的印欧词根属于重构形式。

items.en: Humidus 'moist, wet' was the adjective from humere; it existed beside a variant umidus.
items.cn: humidus「潮湿的」是由 humere 构成的形容词，并与变体 umidus 并存。

items.en: Humiditas 'moistness' added the noun suffix to humidus and named the quality rather than a thing.
items.cn: humiditas「潮湿」在 humidus 上加名词后缀，指性质而非具体事物。

items.en: English humidity appears in the sixteenth century, borrowed through French from the Latin noun, and first meant dampness in general.
items.cn: 英语 humidity 在十六世纪出现，经法语从拉丁名词借入，最初泛指潮湿。

items.en: From the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries humidity became a measured quantity of vapour in the air, with relative and absolute forms.
items.cn: 从十八、十九世纪起，humidity 成为空气中水汽的可测数量，并有相对与绝对两种形式。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Latin source of humere is not established, and the first English date is usually given as the 1530s but is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：humere 在拉丁语之前的来源未得到证明；英语首见通常定为十六世纪三十年代，但只是约数。

note.en: Group one holds words that resemble humidity but belong to other roots; group two holds words for moisture itself.
note.cn: 第一组是外形像 humidity、却属于其他词根的词；第二组是表示潮湿本身的词。

entries.definition: From Latin humilis 'low, humble', from humus 'earth': the quality of being humble. The resemblance to humidity is accidental.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 humilis「低微的、谦卑的」，源于 humus「土地」：谦逊的品质。与 humidity 相似纯属偶然。

entries.definition: Dark organic matter in soil, from Latin humus 'earth'; it is a solid, not water vapour.
entries.definitionCN: 土壤中的深色有机质，来自拉丁 humus「土地」；它是固体，不是水汽。

entries.definition: To add water vapour to the air; it acts on air rather than naming the amount in it.
entries.definitionCN: 向空气加入水汽；作用于空气，而非指其中的数量。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning damp; humidity is the noun for the quantity or quality.
entries.definitionCN: 表示潮湿的形容词；humidity 是表示数量或性质的名词。

entries.definition: Water present in small amounts in air or a material; it names the water, while humidity names the amount in air.
entries.definitionCN: 空气或材料中少量存在的水；它指水本身，humidity 指空气中的含量。

entries.definition: The unpleasant quality of being slightly wet; it is closer to the felt side of humidity.
entries.definitionCN: 轻微潮湿的令人不适的性质；更接近 humidity 的体感一面。

entries.definition: Warm, humid air that feels oppressive; it combines heat with humidity.
entries.definitionCN: 闷热潮湿、令人压抑的空气；把热与湿度合在一起。

entries.definition: Water in its gaseous state; humidity is the measure of how much of it the air holds.
entries.definitionCN: 气态的水；humidity 是空气含有多少这种水的度量。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real word parts, real fixed phrases and real word relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Latin humere 'to be moist' gives humid, humidity, humidify.
normal.cn: 拉丁 humere「潮湿」给出 humid、humidity、humidify。

normal.en: The family runs humidity, humid, humidify, humidifier, dehumidify.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 humidity、humid、humidify、humidifier、dehumidify。

normal.en: Fixed phrases split the measures: relative humidity, absolute humidity, specific humidity.
normal.cn: 固定搭配区分度量：相对湿度、绝对湿度、比湿。

normal.en: Weather reports usually mean relative humidity when they say humidity.
normal.cn: 天气报告说 humidity 时通常指相对湿度。

normal.en: The trap is humility, from humus 'earth', which means modesty.
normal.cn: 陷阱是 humility，出自 humus「土地」，意为谦逊。

abstract.en: Picture a towel on a wall that never dries.
abstract.cn: 想象墙上一条永远不干的毛巾。

abstract.en: Picture a window fogged from the inside in the afternoon.
abstract.cn: 想象午后窗玻璃从内侧蒙上雾。

abstract.en: Picture air holding water the way a sponge holds it, until warmth makes it let go.
abstract.cn: 想象空气像海绵一样含水，直到温度让它松开。

examples.en: Humidity above eighty per cent slows the drying of paint.
examples.cn: 湿度超过八成会拖慢油漆干燥。

examples.en: The instrument logs temperature and humidity every hour.
examples.cn: 仪器每小时记录温度与湿度。

examples.en: Low humidity in winter can dry out the throat.
examples.cn: 冬季低湿度会让喉咙干燥。

dict_mnemonic.text: humid 是潮湿的，-ity 是名词后缀：潮湿的程度 → 湿度；气象上说「湿度」多半指相对湿度，别与谦逊 humility 混了

root: 拉丁 humere「潮湿」→ humidus「潮湿的」→ humiditas「潮湿」→ 英语 humidity；更深印欧词根属重构形式，来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one measured moisture: the vapour in the air, the relative and absolute measures, the per-mass measure, the felt stickiness, the weather figure, the indoor target and the effects on materials and bodies.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一种可测的水汽展开：空气中的水汽、相对与绝对两种度量、按质量计的度量、体感的黏湿、天气报告的数值、室内的目标值，以及对材料与人体的影响。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a towel on a wall that never dries.
core.cn: 核心意象：墙上一条永远不干的毛巾。

branches.en: THE SUBSTANCE: the word first names vapour held in the air.
branches.cn: 物质：这个词首先指空气中持有的水汽。

branches.en: THREE MEASURES: relative to capacity, absolute by volume, specific by mass.
branches.cn: 三种度量：相对容量、按体积的绝对量、按质量的比湿。

branches.en: THE FEELING: the same quantity is felt on the skin as stickiness.
branches.cn: 体感：同一个量在皮肤上被感受为黏湿。

branches.en: THE FIGURE: the forecast prints the quantity beside the temperature.
branches.cn: 数值：预报把这个量与温度并列印出。

branches.en: CONTROL AND CONSEQUENCE: museums hold it steady, and materials pay the price when it is not held.
branches.cn: 控制与后果：博物馆让它稳定，若不稳定材料就要付代价。

intro.en: Humidity is a Latin noun with a Latin adjective inside it, and that adjective also builds the verbs for adding and removing moisture.
intro.cn: humidity 是一个拉丁名词，里面藏着一个拉丁形容词，那个形容词还构成加湿与除湿的动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin humere, humidus and humiditas supply the core, and English adds -ify for the action of making air moist.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 humere、humidus 与 humiditas 提供核心，英语再加 -ify 表示使空气变湿的动作。

items.example: The verb names the state behind the noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词指名词背后的状态。

items.example: The adjective describes the air.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词描述空气。

items.example: The suffix turns the adjective into a noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把形容词变成名词。

items.example: Humidity stayed high all week.
items.exampleCN: 湿度整周居高不下。

items.example: The air felt humid in the shade.
items.exampleCN: 阴凉处的空气也显得潮湿。

items.meaning: to add vapour to the air
items.example: The machine humidifies the greenhouse.
items.exampleCN: 这台机器为温室加湿。

items.example: A humidifier ran beside the bed.
items.exampleCN: 床边开着加湿器。

items.meaning: to take vapour out of the air
items.example: The cellar must be dehumidified.
items.exampleCN: 地窖必须除湿。

items.example: A hygrometer hung by the window.
items.exampleCN: 窗边挂着一只湿度计。

definition_zh: 潮湿的；湿润的；闷热的（空气或天气）
definition_en: containing a lot of water vapour; damp and often uncomfortably warm
core_image: 热带雨季的午后，墙壁摸上去发潮，风扇吹来的风也是热的
scene: 热带雨季的午后，墙壁摸上去发潮，风扇吹来的风带着热气。The air felt humid even in the shade of the veranda.
sceneCN: 这里 humid 指「空气含水汽多、潮湿的」（第 1 个义项：空气潮湿的）；句意为即使站在走廊的阴凉处，空气仍然潮湿。图中可辨识物件：潮湿的墙、风扇、走廊阴影、水汽。

pos.zh: 潮湿的；湿润的
闷热的；湿热难当的

senses.title: Damp air
senses.definition: describing air that holds a great deal of water vapour
senses.definitionCN: 形容空气含有大量水汽
senses.example: The air felt humid even in the shade of the veranda.
senses.exampleCN: 即使站在走廊的阴凉处，空气仍然潮湿。
senses.why: Latin humidus simply meant moist, and English kept that plain physical sense first.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 humidus 本义就是潮湿，英语最先保留了这个朴素的物理义。

senses.title: A wet climate
senses.definition: describing a region or season with high moisture and frequent rain
senses.definitionCN: 形容一个地区或季节水汽高、降雨频繁
senses.example: Rice grows well in a humid climate.
senses.exampleCN: 水稻在湿润的气候里长得好。
senses.why: a region's moisture is what makes a climate humid, not a single day.
senses.whyCN: 使气候算得上湿润的是一个地区的水汽，而不是某一天。

senses.title: Oppressively warm and damp
senses.definition: describing warmth made worse by moisture, so that the body cannot cool
senses.definitionCN: 形容潮湿使炎热更难忍受，身体无法散热
senses.example: The humid heat kept everyone indoors at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 湿热的暑气让正午时人人都待在室内。
senses.why: moisture slows evaporation, and the word absorbed that discomfort.
senses.whyCN: 水汽减慢蒸发，这个词就吸收了这种不适。

senses.title: A moist air mass
senses.titleCN: 气象学上含大量水汽的气团
senses.definition: technical: describing an air mass whose vapour content is high
senses.definitionCN: 技术用法：形容水汽含量高的气团
senses.example: A humid air mass from the sea met a cold front inland.
senses.exampleCN: 来自海上的湿气团在内陆遇上冷锋。
senses.why: meteorology needs a label for vapour-rich air, and the adjective serves it.
senses.whyCN: 气象学需要给富含水汽的空气一个标签，这个形容词就服务于此。

senses.title: A damp room
senses.definition: describing a room, wall or building that feels or stays wet
senses.definitionCN: 形容房间、墙壁或建筑摸上去或一直是湿的
senses.example: The humid cellar smelled of old stone.
senses.exampleCN: 潮湿的地窖散发着旧石头的味道。
senses.why: a room that stays wet earns the adjective just as air does.
senses.whyCN: 一直湿着的房间也像空气一样配得上这个形容词。

senses.title: A moist habitat
senses.definition: describing an environment wet enough for moisture-loving plants and animals
senses.definitionCN: 形容环境足够湿润，适合喜湿的动植物
senses.example: Ferns cover the humid slopes above the stream.
senses.exampleCN: 蕨类铺满溪流上方湿润的坡地。
senses.why: plants that need moisture mark their habitats with the word.
senses.whyCN: 需要水汽的植物用这个词来标记它们的栖息地。

senses.title: Causing dampness
senses.definition: describing conditions that make objects, clothes or food damp
senses.definitionCN: 形容使物品、衣物或食物受潮的状况
senses.example: The humid weather left the salt in lumps.
senses.exampleCN: 潮湿的天气让盐结成了块。
senses.why: if the air will not take more water, objects keep the damp.
senses.whyCN: 如果空气不再收水，物品就把潮湿留住。

senses.title: The feel of a wet season
senses.definition: describing the characteristic air of a rainy season
senses.definitionCN: 形容雨季特有的空气感
senses.example: Everything in the humid season dries slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 雨季里什么东西都干得慢。
senses.why: a whole season can have a character, and the adjective names it.
senses.whyCN: 整个季节也能有一种性格，这个形容词为它命名。

intro.en: Humid comes from Latin humidus 'moist', an adjective from humere 'to be moist'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: humid 来自拉丁 humidus「潮湿的」，它是 humere「潮湿」的形容词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Humere meant 'to be moist' or 'to be wet'. Its deeper origin is not established; the Indo-European root often cited for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: humere 意为「潮湿、湿」。其更深来源未得到证明，常为它引用的印欧词根属重构形式。

items.en: Humidus 'moist, wet' was formed from humere and existed beside the variant umidus.
items.cn: humidus「潮湿的」由 humere 构成，并与变体 umidus 并存。

items.en: English humid appears in the sixteenth century, borrowed through French, and first described damp air and damp ground.
items.cn: 英语 humid 在十六世纪出现，经法语借入，最初描述潮湿的空气与地面。

items.en: The word settled into weather description, especially for warm air full of vapour.
items.cn: 这个词稳定用于天气描写，尤指饱含水汽的暖空气。

items.en: Meteorology uses it for air masses with high vapour content, and the noun humidity carries the measured value.
items.cn: 气象学用它形容水汽含量高的气团，名词 humidity 则承载测得的数值。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the pre-Latin source of humere is not established, and its first English date is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：humere 在拉丁语之前的来源未得到证明，它在英语中的首见年代也只是约数。

note.en: Group one holds words that look like humid but come from other roots; group two holds adjectives for wetness and sticky heat.
note.cn: 第一组是外形像 humid、却来自其他词根的词；第二组是表示潮湿与湿热黏腻的形容词。

entries.definition: From Latin humilis 'low' and humus 'earth': modesty. It shares letters with humid but not a root.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 humilis「低微的」与 humus「土地」：谦逊。它与 humid 共享字母，却不共词根。

entries.definition: Organic matter in soil, from Latin humus; it is solid earth, not moist air.
entries.definitionCN: 土壤中的有机质，来自拉丁 humus；它是固体泥土，不是潮湿空气。

entries.definition: To make the air moist; it is an action, while humid is a state.
entries.definitionCN: 使空气潮湿；它是动作，而 humid 是状态。

entries.definition: Relating to the four bodily humours of old medicine; the root is humor 'fluid', not humidity.
entries.definitionCN: 与旧医学的四种体液有关；词根是 humor「液体」，不是湿度。

entries.definition: Slightly wet, often in an unpleasant way; humidusually describes air rather than a surface.
entries.definitionCN: 轻微潮湿，常带不快意味；humid 通常描述空气，而非表面。

entries.definition: Slightly wet in a neutral or pleasant way, as cake or eyes; humid is about air.
entries.definitionCN: 中性或宜人的轻微湿润，如蛋糕或眼睛；humid 讲的是空气。

entries.definition: Unpleasantly warm and damp, used of weather; it adds heat to humidity's moisture.
entries.definitionCN: 令人不适的湿热天气；在 humidity 的水汽之上加了热。

entries.definition: Describing air or a surface that feels adhesive because of moisture; it is the body's impression.
entries.definitionCN: 形容空气或表面因水汽而黏手；是身体的感受。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real word parts, real fixed phrases and real word relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Latin humere 'to be moist' gives humid, humidity, humidify.
normal.cn: 拉丁 humere「潮湿」给出 humid、humidity、humidify。

normal.en: The family runs humid, humidity, humidly, humidness, dehumidify.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 humid、humidity、humidly、humidness、dehumidify。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: humid air, humid climate, hot and humid.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：潮湿的空气、湿润的气候、又热又潮。

normal.en: The trap is humility, from humus 'earth', meaning modesty.
normal.cn: 陷阱是 humility，出自 humus「土地」，意为谦逊。

normal.en: Humid is about air; damp and moist usually describe surfaces.
normal.cn: humid 讲空气；damp 与 moist 通常描述表面。

abstract.en: Picture a wall you touch and find wet in the afternoon.
abstract.cn: 想象午后摸一面墙，手上是湿的。

abstract.en: Picture a fan pushing warm air that never cools the skin.
abstract.cn: 想象风扇吹着暖风，皮肤却始终不凉。

abstract.en: Picture salt in a bowl slowly turning into lumps.
abstract.cn: 想象碗里的盐慢慢结成块。

examples.en: The humid air made the laundry take two days to dry.
examples.cn: 潮湿的空气让洗好的衣物两天才干。

examples.en: Summers here are hot and humid.
examples.cn: 这里的夏天又热又潮湿。

examples.en: Mould grows quickly in humid cellars.
examples.cn: 霉菌在潮湿的地窖里长得很快。

dict_mnemonic.text: humid 就是「潮湿的」，名词是 humidity（湿度）：空气里水汽多，摸上去湿、身上又闷

root: 拉丁 humere「潮湿」→ humidus「潮湿的」→ 经法语进入英语 humid；更深印欧词根属重构形式，来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one kind of air: damp air, a wet climate, oppressive warmth, a moist air mass, a damp room, a wet habitat, conditions that make things damp and the feel of a rainy season.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一种空气展开：潮湿的空气、湿润的气候、闷热难当、潮湿气团、潮湿地窖、湿润栖息地、使物受潮的天气，以及雨季的湿气感。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wall that feels wet under the palm in the afternoon.
core.cn: 核心意象：午后掌心按上去发热发湿的一面墙。

branches.en: THE PHYSICAL AIR: damp air on the skin and a moist air mass on a map.
branches.cn: 物理的空气：皮肤上的潮湿空气与图上的湿气团。

branches.en: THE WET SEASON: climate, oppressive heat and the feel of the rains belong together.
branches.cn: 雨季：气候、湿热与雨季的体感属于一体。

branches.en: THE ROOM: a cellar stays wet because the air will not take the water.
branches.cn: 房间：地窖一直湿着，因为空气不肯收水。

branches.en: THE HABITAT: ferns mark the slopes where moisture stays.
branches.cn: 栖息地：蕨类标记出水汽停留的坡地。

branches.en: THE CONSEQUENCE: salt lumps and laundry hangs in the same weather.
branches.cn: 后果：同一场天气里盐结块、衣物晾不干。

intro.en: Humid is a Latin adjective whose root also builds the noun for the measured quantity and the verbs for adding or removing moisture.
intro.cn: humid 是一个拉丁形容词，其词根还构成表示可测数量的名词，以及加湿与除湿的动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin humere and humidus supply the core; English adds -ity for the noun and the prefix de- for removal.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 humere 与 humidus 提供核心；英语加 -ity 构成名词，加前缀 de- 表示去除。

items.example: The verb names the state.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词指状态。

items.example: The adjective describes the air.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词描述空气。

items.example: The air felt humid.
items.exampleCN: 空气显得潮湿。

items.meaning: the amount of vapour in the air
items.example: Humidity stayed high.
items.exampleCN: 湿度居高不下。

items.example: The room was humidly warm.
items.exampleCN: 房间潮热。

items.example: Humidness is hard to measure by feel.
items.exampleCN: 潮湿的程度很难靠感觉测量。

items.example: The unit humidifies the nursery.
items.exampleCN: 这台设备为育婴室加湿。

items.example: Dehumidify the archive in summer.
items.exampleCN: 夏季要给档案室除湿。

items.example: The hygrometer read ninety per cent.
items.exampleCN: 湿度计读数为九成。

latinEntries.structure: humidus, humida, humidum (adj., first and second declension)
